This art raised us from what we were to what we are.|[[Rattagagech]] to [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]|<ref name="Tyrant's Test">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref>}}
The '''Elomin''' were horned humanoids from [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]] who lived on the surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] while another sentient species—the [[Elom/Legends|Elom]]—lived underground.

{{Species-stub}}

==Biology and appearance==
Elomin skin featured a variety of colors from bright pink to dark purple. Features of their anatomy which distinguished them from baseline humans included neck wattles, [[spanchon]]s, four [[Stomach/Legends|stomachs]], [[generative node]]s, six-chambered [[Heart/Legends|hearts]], [[Nose/Legends|nose]] tusks, long hairs which grew behind their ears, and horns. They were capable of living up to 110 years old; children were between 1-5 whilst they went through adolescence between 6-12 and were considered full adults by 13-40. Middle-age followed between the ages of 41-60, and those aged 61-72 were considered old.

==Society and culture==
[[File:Elom-Elomin_NEGAS.jpg|thumb|left|180px|An Elomin and an [[Elom/Legends|Elom]].]]

Elomin strove to find order in things and worked to create order where none existed. Therefore, they were unable to cope with the unstructured attack of a perfectly executed [[Marg Sabl/Legends|Marg Sabl]] maneuver. The Elomin were obsessed with personal hygiene, combing their long ear hair and polishing their horns.

==History==
The Elomin were thought by some [[Archaeology/Legends|xenoarchaeologists]] to be descended from a lost colony of [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] who settled Elom in the distant past.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> 

The Elomin inhabited the surface of their planet, initially unaware that another intelligent species inhabited the crust below. The Elom had once lived on the surface, but were forced to move underground when [[Water/Legends|water]] became scarce. They remained isolated, continuing to retreat further underground. When the Elomin re-discovered the Eloms, their government tried to convince the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that they were only unintelligent animals, and pressed them in to service as servants and laborers. The truth was eventually discovered, and Eloms were granted the same rights as other sentient species. Despite their newly bestowed suffrage, Eloms did not seem to be interested in politics, and continued to live in their burrows. The Elomin continued to govern the world of Elom and represented the planet offworld. When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] came to power, they enslaved the Elomin to work in their own [[Lommite/Legends|lommite]] mines.<ref name="AE" /> The Eloms staged raids and rescued numerous Elomin from slavery. After their planet was liberated by the Republic, the two species began integrating their societies together.

In the year [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], an [[Elomin task force]] was engaged and destroyed by Grand Admiral [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]. They chased an Imperial scan raiding party from the [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]] Region and back to Thrawn's flagship, the [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']]. Thrawn then annihilated the superior task force by exploiting the species' inability to cope with a well-executed [[Marg Sabl/Legends|Marg Sabl]].

==Notable Elomin==
Notable Elomin included [[Verrinnefra B'thog Indriummsegh]], a signatory to the [[Declaration of a New Republic/Legends|Declaration of a New Republic]] and a member of the [[New Republic Provisional Council]]; [[Monjai]] served as governor of [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]] following its liberation from the Empire; [[Te Corso]] was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]].
